take_homes: Put the material in a folder with the agent's rules, and the answers can cite my own files. Citation is how I check it.
Keep originals untouched and have the agent propose changes I approve. That gives me an audit trail and a human decision.
The folder is mine and the model underneath can be swapped, so it's not just a licence I rent.

monday.move: Ask the controller and IT what would be needed to try the month-end variance commentary on an approved tool with finance data, and what it costs per month for 40 people.
monday.stop_condition: If there's no per-seat cost and no data-policy answer by end of week, I drop it.
monday.blocker: IT has not approved the tool for finance data.

misconception.why: The point that the folder and rules are mine while the model changes made me see it as something the organisation builds. But the module never gave a cost, payback or org-level number, so I'm only half convinced.

one_line: Reasonable idea, citations and approval steps are checkable, but a day of building a notes folder with no cost or payback figure; I'd send my controller, not myself.
